    n = int(data[0])
    H = [0] + [int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]]
    f = [0] * (n + 2)
    nge = [n + 1] * (n + 2)
    stack = []
    for k in range(n, 0, -1):
        while stack and H[stack[-1]] < H[k]:
            stack.pop()
        nge[k] = stack[-1] if stack else n + 1
        stack.append(k)
        f[k] = 1 + f[nge[k]]
    res = []
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        if i + 1 <= n:
            res.append(f[i + 1])
        else:
